title: Any authenticated user can cancel any other user's order
owner_hint: top committer: Rob Conery (1 of 1 recent commit); no CODEOWNERS entry
rationale: Cancel loads the order by the body-supplied number and cancels it without comparing the caller's sub. The diff adds an ownership gate in CancelOrderAsync using IIdentityService and a new OrderBelongsToUserAsync predicate on Buyer.IdentityGuid, returning a uniform 404 before the command is dispatched. The shared handler is deliberately untouched because the payment-failure broker path also cancels orders with no user context.
variants_checked: Cancel fixed; GetOrderAsync and ShipOrderAsync are separate findings; the broker-driven cancel path stays functional; the new predicate mirrors GetOrdersFromUserAsync.
bypass_considered: Spoofing buyer fields is impossible because the command carries only OrderNumber and identity comes from the sub claim; replaying an x-requestid does not re-dispatch.
test_note: Added Cancel_order_owned_by_another_user_returns_not_found and updated the functional expectation from 500 to 404.
review_reason: The guard runs before command construction and authorizes on the server-derived sub via a predicate that reuses the same Buyer.IdentityGuid join as the list query. Leaving the shared handler untouched is correct because the broker path cancels without a user. Only nits are a ProblemHttpResult instead of a typed NotFound and no log on the denied branch.
